text: 乌云逐渐遮蔽天空。雷声轰鸣，预示着一场暴雨。你看见闪光，紧接着传来惊天巨响，震得耳膜生疼。“哇！”西尔维娅说，“刚才一定劈中了附近什么东西！”
确实如此。山坡上的干灌木丛冒起了烟。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 294
text: The sky darkens with building thunderheads. A roar splits the heavens, promising a heavy storm. You see a flash, and almost immediately, an almighty crack that jolts the eardrums. “Wow!” says Sylvia. “That must have hit somewhere nearby!”
It did. Smoke rises from the dry brush up the hill.
